summary: Feb 2 follow-up says police recorded statements from 10 people and opened two investigation papers concerning the two Jan 27 embassy gatherings. This is not a new February protest. Because the story does not distinguish which organizers/participants correspond to each of the two investigations, response is not allocated to a specific January candidate here.
open_questions: Whether the two investigations map separately to the Jan 27 HTM sequence and the later PAS/PN rally is not stated; the NGO embassy delegation may also be among gatherings described. Keep event linkage and response attribution unresolved.
